$comment: Ingestion source of truth (SPEC §3). Seeded from docs/research/corpus-viability.md §1. kinds: sinalevi (3-call API, idFichaNorma; vigente version resolved at fetch), hacienda-pdf (Playwright fetch — WAF blocks plain HTTP), cabys (curated dev-relevant subset, task #8), unresolved (official source to locate during ingestion; never ingest secondary commentary). deepLink (#134): audited per source — how deep the official URL can be linked. `articulo` = SINALEVI ficha; the viewer opens one artículo at Informacion?param1=<ficha>&param2=<idVersionNorma>&param3=3&param4=<idArticulo>, and `source.articulos` (artículo number → idArticulo) is harvested at ingestion from the «Ficha Artículo» rail in the full-text payload — _BuscarArticulo answers -1 for our fichas, so the rail is the only mapping. `page` = PDF whose primary text is a page range; the chip appends #page=<first page>. `none` = the document root is the deepest honest link, with the reason in that entry's notes. imagesAudited (#177): for entries carrying an IMAGE AUDIT note, every image src a human looked at in that audit — ingestion logs a quiet receipt while the payload stays inside this set, and the full #150 warning naming the new srcs the moment a re-crawl adds one.

documents.title: Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado (texto consolidado)
Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 5 images, all rendered formulas; 2 lose substance no chunk carries. (a) Artículo 31 inciso 4) — the bien-de-capital adjustment (Ca₀ − Caᵢ)/4 is image-only, so the text reads «El ajuste en cada año deberá calcularse utilizando la siguiente fórmula:» straight into «Donde:». Never cite this artículo for how the adjustment is computed; the conditions, the 15-salarios-base threshold, the i = 1..4 range and the sign rule ARE in text. (b) The retención percentage %RT = FR × (TM/13%) × 1/(1+TM) is image-only; the prose names every input and says it is deflated to exclude the IVA, but not the composition. The other 3 restate adjacent prose verbatim and lose nothing. Text-carrying primary source located but NOT ingested: La Gaceta Alcance 129 del 2019-06-11 carries both as selectable text — safe for (b), whose vigente wording is unchanged, but NOT for (a), which decreto 43173 del 3 de agosto de 2021 reformed after that publication. See #150 for the evidence.

documents.title: Ley de Fortalecimiento de las Finanzas Públicas
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 3 images, all rendered formulas, all 3 image-only — and they are the same three the reglamento-renta ficha carries, because this ficha quotes TRANSITORIO I of the Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta in full under TRANSITORIO XIX. Same verdict, same reason for not replacing them: the rule is spent (fiscal periods closing 2020-12-31, pagos parciales 2021–2023). See the reglamento-renta note and #150.

documents.title: Reglamento al Título IV de la Ley 9635 (renta)
Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 3 images, all rendered formulas, all 3 image-only — the proration rules in TRANSITORIO I («Disposiciones sobre el Transitorio XIX de la Ley 9635»): tramo de renta and crédito fiscal prorated as (valor del periodo ordinario / 12) × meses del periodo, and impuesto determinado re-annualised as (impuesto 2020 / meses del periodo) × 12. Each chunk keeps «deberán utilizar la siguiente fórmula:» and loses the formula. Not replaced: the rule governs fiscal periods closing 2020-12-31 and pagos parciales for 2021–2023 — spent as of 2026, so ingesting a source for it would add dead law rather than an answerable fact. Never cite this Transitorio for a computation; the rest of the reglamento is unaffected.

documents.title: CCSS — Base Mínima Contributiva (decreto)
documents.notes: Annual churn — verify vigente version each re-crawl; figures only from primary decree. CARRIES NO RATES (#114): the escala contributiva table is a raster image in the SINALEVI payload (image005.png), not markup, so HTML→text extraction cannot recover it — the ingested text jumps from «Establecer la siguiente escala contributiva» to «Notas:». Same for the sibling ficha 82804. The doc is kept for Acuerdos Segundo–Cuarto (how the BMC is adjusted when the minimum wage moves); never cite it for a percentage or a BMC amount — those live in ccss-escala-salud, ccss-escala-ivm and salarios-minimos, ingested from the CCSS actas that transcribe the same tables as text. Deep link articulo (#134) — the acuerdos are numbered artículos in the ficha rail.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de IVM
documents.norma: Ficha técnica PE-DAE-1179-2025 (acuerdo Junta Directiva, artículo 4°, sesión 9570)
documents.notes: Carries the IVM rates by income bracket (afiliado 4.16–8.42%, conjunta 9.91% + 1.75% Estado como tal = 11.66% global). Brackets are in SM multiples, so they stay correct across wage decrees — resolve colón amounts via salarios-minimos. Adopted verbatim by the Junta Directiva on 2025-12-18 (9 votos en firme) per artículo 33 and Transitorio XI del Reglamento del Seguro de IVM; rige hasta 2028-12-31, next escalón 2029 — re-crawl then. Ingested from the sesión's anexos zip because SINALEVI publishes CCSS escala acuerdos as raster images (#114). Deep link none (#134): the official URL is a zip, so the browser downloads it — no fragment reaches the PDF inside. IMAGE AUDIT (#175): the gradualidad table this ficha técnica quotes — the salaried patrono/trabajador split behind the 11.66% global, and the 2029 escalón — is a raster image in every primary channel that publishes it, this document included (page 1 of the ficha técnica, a 765×614 JPEG): SINALEVI ficha 26485, the sesión 9038 reform ficha 89493, CCSS's own reglamento PDF, acta 9038 and the official La Gaceta 161 / Alcance 191 del 2019-08-28 all read «…se realizará con la siguiente gradualidad:» straight into the paragraph after the table. Never cite this document for the patrono/trabajador split or the 2029 rate; the independent-worker escala it was ingested for is unaffected. Text-carrying primary source located but NOT ingested: the consulta pública propuesta in La Gaceta 62 del 2019-03-28 sets the whole table out as text, but it is the proposal, not the adopted schedule — it dates the 11.66% escalón 2025-2027 and 12.16% from 2028, where the acuerdo (rige 2020-01-01) put them at 2026-01-01→2028-12-31 and 2029-01-01. See corpus-viability §1 and #175 for the evidence.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de Salud
documents.notes: Salud rates by income bracket (afiliado 2.89–10.69%, conjunta 12.00% + 0.25% Estado como tal), still vigente — the 2026 adjustment touched IVM only (see ccss-escala-ivm). documents.title: Fijación de salarios mínimos para el sector privado (vigente 2026)
documents.notes: La Gaceta 229, Alcance 156. Supplies the SM the CCSS escalas are denominated in — Trabajadores en Ocupación No Calificada ¢373.092,30/mes, from which the vigente base mínima contributiva follows: 0.87 SM = ¢324.590 (IVM) and 0.9295 SM = ¢346.789 (SEM), both matching CCSS's published BMC. Annual churn — re-fetch each wage decree; the alcance number and page range change every year. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 165, where the decree starts inside the alcance.

documents.title: Reglamento del Régimen de Tributación Simplificada
documents.notes: Key fact: artículo 1 is a closed list of eligible activities (software and professional services absent) and artículo 2 bars entry to anyone with activities outside it — artículo 3 carries the thresholds. Vigente text consolidates reform 45209-H; re-verify the activity list each re-crawl. Rationale, provenance and the replaced `rts-requisitos` flyer: docs/research/corpus-viability.md §1 and issue #108.

documents.title: Disposiciones técnicas de comprobantes electrónicos v4.4
documents.notes: Mandatory since 2025-09-01. SINALEVI vigente text is consolidated with reforms MH-DGT-RES-0001-2025 and MH-DGT-RES-0043-2025 — preferred over the original hacienda.go.cr PDF (Resolucion_General_sobre_disposiciones_tecnicas_comprobantes_electronicos_para.pdf), whose transition dates are superseded. IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 10 images, none carrying substance — 8 are Word drawing-canvas strokes (arrows and 2px rules, 2×20 to 242×2) and 2 are diagrams of digit layouts (image007.jpg, the 20-digit numeración consecutiva; image009.png, the 50-digit clave numérica). Both diagrams are redundant: incisos a)–d) and a)–h) give every field range in text, down to «del cuadragésimo tercero al quincuagésimo dígito, corresponde al código de seguridad». Nothing to replace.
